1.text: Tha word of tha LORD dat came 2 Micah tha Morasthite in tha days of Jotham, Ahaz, N Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria N Jerusalem.
Hear, all y’all people; listen, O earth, N all dat in it is: N let tha Lord GOD be witness against u, tha Lord from his holy temple.
4, look, tha LORD comes forth out of his place, N will come down, N tread upon tha high places of tha earth.
N tha mountains shall be molten under him, N tha valleys shall be cleft, as wax before tha fire, N as tha waterz dat r poured down a steep place.
4 tha transgression of Jacob is all dis, N 4 tha sins of tha house of Israel. What is tha transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? N what r tha high places of Judah? r dey not Jerusalem?
Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of tha field, N as plantings of a vineyard: N I will pour down tha stones of it in2 tha valley, N I will discover tha foundations of it.

N all tha graven images of it shall be beaten 2 pieces, N all tha hires of it shall be burned wit tha fire, N all tha idols of it will I lay desolate: 4 she gathered it of tha hire of an harlot, N dey shall return 2 tha hire of an harlot.
Therefore I will wail N howl, I will go stripped N naked: I will make a wailing like tha dragons, N mournin as tha owls.
4 her wound is incurable; 4 it is come 2 Judah; he is come 2 tha gate of my people, even 2 Jerusalem.
Declare y’all it not at Gath, weep y’all not at all: in tha house of Aphrah roll urself in tha dust.
Pass y’all away, u inhabitant of Saphir, havin ur shame naked: tha inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in tha mournin of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of u his standin.
4 tha inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully 4 good: but evil came down from tha LORD 2 tha gate of Jerusalem.
O u inhabitant of Lachish, bind tha chariot 2 tha swift beast: she is tha beginning of tha sin 2 tha daughter of Zion: 4 tha transgressions of Israel were found in u.
Therefore will u give presents 2 Moresheth-gath: tha houses of Achzib shall be a lie 2 tha kings of Israel.
Yet will I bring an heir 2 u, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come 2 Adullam tha glory of Israel.
Make u bald, N poll u 4 ur delicate children; enlarge ur baldness as tha eagle; 4 dey r gone in2 captivity from u.

2.text: Woe 2 ’em dat devise iniquity, N work evil upon their beds! when tha morning is light, dey practise it, because it is in tha power of their hand.
N dey covet fields, N take ’em by violence; N houses, N take ’em away: so dey oppress a man N his house, even a man N his heritage.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD; look, against dis family do I devise an evil, from which y’all shall not remove ur necks; neither shall y’all go haughtily: 4 dis time is evil.

In dat day shall one take up a parable against u, N lament wit a doleful lamentation, N say, We be utterly spoiled: he has changed tha portion of my people: how has he removed it from me! turnin away he has divided our fields.
Therefore u will have none dat shall cast a cord by lot in tha congregation of tha LORD.
Prophesy y’all not, say dey 2 ’em dat prophesy: dey shall not prophesy 2 ’em, dat dey shall not take shame.
O u dat art named tha house of Jacob, is tha spirit of tha LORD straitened? r dese his doings? do not my words do good 2 him dat walks uprightly?
Even of late my people is risen up as an opp: y’all pull off tha robe wit tha garment from ’em dat pass by securely as men averse from war.
Tha women of my people have y’all cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have y’all taken away my glory 4 ever.
Arise y’all, N depart; 4 dis is not ur rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy u, even wit a sore destruction.
If a man walkin in tha spirit N falsehood do lie, sayin, I will prophesy 2 u of wine N of strong drink; he shall even be tha prophet of dis people.

I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of u; I will surely gather tha remnant of Israel; I will put ’em together as tha sheep of Bozrah, as tha flock in tha midst of their fold: dey shall make great noise by reason of tha crowd of men.
Tha breaker is come up before ’em: dey have broken up, N have passed through tha gate, N r gone out by it: N their king shall pass before ’em, N tha LORD on tha head of ’em.

3.text: N I said, Hear, I pray u, O heads of Jacob, N y’all princes of tha house of Israel; Is it not 4 u 2 know judgment?
Who hate tha good, N love tha evil; who pluck off their skin from off ’em, N their flesh from off their bones;
Who also eat tha flesh of my people, N flay their skin from off ’em; N dey break their bones, N chop ’em in pieces, as 4 tha pot, N as flesh within tha caldron.
Then shall dey cry 2 tha LORD, but he will not hear ’em: he will even hide his face from ’em at dat time, as dey have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
Like dis says tha LORD concerning tha prophets dat make my people err, dat bite wit their teeth, N cry, Peace; N he dat puts not in2 their mouths, dey even prepare war against him.
Therefore night shall be 2 u, dat y’all shall not have a vision; N it will be dark 2 u, dat y’all shall not divine; N tha sun shall go down over tha prophets, N tha day shall be dark over ’em.
Then shall tha seers be ashamed, N tha diviners confounded: yeah, dey shall all cover their lips; 4 there is no answer of God.
But truly I am full of power by tha spirit of tha LORD, N of judgment, N of might, 2 declare 2 Jacob his transgression, N 2 Israel his sin.
Hear dis, I pray u, y’all heads of tha house of Jacob, N princes of tha house of Israel, dat abhor judgment, N pervert all equity.
Dey build up Zion wit blood, N Jerusalem wit iniquity.
Tha heads of it judge 4 reward, N tha priests of it teach 4 hire, N tha prophets of it divine 4 money: yet will dey lean upon tha LORD, N say, Is not tha LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
Therefore shall Zion 4 ur sake be plowed as a field, N Jerusalem shall become heaps, N tha mountain of tha house as tha high places of tha forest.

4.text: But in tha last days it will happen, dat tha mountain of tha house of tha LORD shall be established in tha top of tha mountains, N it will be exalted above tha hills; N people shall flow 2 it.

N many nations shall come, N say, Come, N let us go up 2 tha mountain of tha LORD, N 2 tha house of tha God of Jacob; N he will teach us of his ways, N we will walk in his paths: 4 tha law shall go forth of Zion, N tha word of tha LORD from Jerusalem.

N he shall judge among many people, N rebuke strong nations afar off; N dey shall beat their swords in2 plowshares, N their spears in2 pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall dey learn war any more.
But dey shall sit every man under his vine N under his fig tree; N none shall make ’em afraid: 4 tha mouth of tha LORD of hosts has spoken it.
4 all people will walk every one in tha name of his god, N we will walk in tha name of tha LORD our God 4 ever N ever.
In dat day, says tha LORD, will I assemble her dat halteth, N I will gather her dat is driven out, N her dat I have afflicted;
N I will make her dat halted a remnant, N her dat was cast far off a strong nation: N tha LORD shall reign over ’em in mount Zion from from now on, even 4 ever.
N u, O tower of tha flock, tha strong hold of tha daughter of Zion, 2 u shall it come, even tha first dominion; tha kingdom shall come 2 tha daughter of Jerusalem.
Now why do u cry out aloud? is there no king in u? is ur counsellor perished? 4 pangs have taken u as a woman in travail.

Be in pain, N labour 2 bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: 4 now will u go forth out of tha city, N u will live in tha field, N u will go even 2 Babylon; there will u be delivered; there tha LORD shall redeem u from tha hand of thine opps.
Now also many nations r gathered against u, dat say, Let her be defiled, N let our eye look upon Zion.
But dey know not tha thoughts of tha LORD, neither understand dey his counsel: 4 he shall gather ’em as tha sheaves in2 tha floor.

Arise N thresh, O daughter of Zion: 4 I will make thine horn iron, N I will make ur hoofs brass: N u will beat in pieces many people: N I will consecrate their gain 2 tha LORD, N their substance 2 tha Lord of tha whole earth.

5.text: Now gather urself in troops, O daughter of troops: he has laid siege against us: dey shall strike tha judge of Israel wit a rod upon tha cheek.

But u, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though u be little among tha thousands of Judah, yet out of u shall he come forth 2 me dat is 2 be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
Therefore will he give ’em up, until tha time dat she which labors has brought forth: then tha remnant of his brothers shall return 2 tha children of Israel.
N he shall stand N feed in tha strength of tha LORD, in tha majesty of tha name of tha LORD his God; N dey shall abide: 4 now shall he be great 2 tha ends of tha earth.
N dis man shall be tha peace, when tha Assyrian shall come in2 our land: N when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, N eight principal men.

N dey shall waste tha land of Assyria wit tha sword, N tha land of Nimrod in tha entrances of it: like dis shall he deliver us from tha Assyrian, when he comes in2 our land, N when he treads within our borders.
N tha remnant of Jacob shall be in tha midst of many people as a dew from tha LORD, as tha showers upon tha grass, dat tarrieth not 4 man, nor waits 4 tha sons of men.

N tha remnant of Jacob shall be among tha Gentiles in tha midst of many people as a lion among tha beasts of tha forest, as a young lion among tha flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treads down, N tears in pieces, N none can deliver.
Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, N all thine opps shall be cut off.
N it will happen in dat day, says tha LORD, dat I will cut off ur horses out of tha midst of u, N I will destroy ur chariots:
N I will cut off tha citiez of ur land, N throw down all ur strong holds:
N I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; N u will have no more soothsayers:
Ur graven images also will I cut off, N ur standin images out of tha midst of u; N u will no more worship tha work of thine hands.
N I will pluck up ur groves out of tha midst of u: so will I destroy ur citiez.
N I will execute vengeance in anger N fury upon tha heathen, such as dey have not heard.

6.text: Hear y’all now what tha LORD says; Arise, contend u before tha mountains, N let tha hills hear ur voice.
Hear y’all, O mountains, tha LORD’s controversy, N y’all strong foundations of tha earth: 4 tha LORD has a controversy wit his people, N he will plead wit Israel.
O my people, what have I done 2 u? N in which have I wearied u? testify against me.
4 I brought u up out of tha land of Egypt, N redeemed u out of tha house of servants; N I sent before u Moses, Aaron, N Miriam.
O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, N what Balaam tha son of Beor answered him from Shittim 2 Gilgal; dat y’all may know tha righteousness of tha LORD.
Wherewith shall I come before tha LORD, N bow myself before tha high God? shall I come before him wit burnt offerings, wit calves of a year old?
Will tha LORD be pleased wit thousands of rams, or wit ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn 4 my transgression, tha fruit of my body 4 tha sin of my soul?
He has showed u, O man, what is good; N what does tha LORD require of u, but 2 do justly, N 2 love mercy, N 2 walk humbly wit ur God?
Tha LORD’s voice cries 2 tha city, N tha man of wisdom shall see ur name: hear y’all tha rod, N who has appointed it.
R there yet tha treasures of wickedness in tha house of tha wicked, N tha scant measure dat is abominable?
Shall I count ’em pure wit tha wicked balances, N wit tha bag of deceitful weights?
4 tha rich men of it r full of violence, N tha inhabitants of it have spoken lies, N their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
Therefore also will I make u sick in strikin u, in makin u desolate because of ur sins.
u will eat, but not be satisfied; N ur castin down shall be in tha midst of u; N u will take hold, but will not deliver; N dat which u deliver will I give up 2 tha sword.
u will sow, but u will not reap; u will tread tha olives, but u will not anoint u wit oil; N sweet wine, but will not drink wine.

4 tha statutes of Omri r kept, N all tha works of tha house of Ahab, N y’all walk in their counsels; dat I should make u a desolation, N tha inhabitants of it an hissing: therefore y’all shall bear tha reproach of my people.

7.text: Woe is me! 4 I am as when dey have gathered tha summer fruits, as tha grapegleanings of tha vintage: there is no cluster 2 eat: my soul desired tha firstripe fruit.
Tha good man is perished out of tha earth: N there is none upright among men: dey all lie in wait 4 blood; dey hunt every man his brother wit a net.
Dat dey may do evil wit both hands earnestly, tha prince asks, N tha judge asks 4 a reward; N tha great man, he utters his mischievous desire: so dey wrap it up.
Tha best of ’em is as a brier: tha most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: tha day of ur watchmen N ur visitation comes; now shall be their perplexity.
Trust y’all not in a friend, put y’all not confidence in a guide: keep tha doors of ur mouth from her dat lies in ur bosom.
4 tha son dishonoureth tha father, tha daughter rises up against her mother, tha daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s opps r tha men of his own house.
Therefore I will look 2 tha LORD; I will wait 4 tha God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Rejoice not against me, O mine opp: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, tha LORD shall be a light 2 me.
I will bear tha indignation of tha LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, N execute judgment 4 me: he will bring me forth 2 tha light, N I shall look his righteousness.
Then she dat is mine opp shall see it, N shame shall cover her which said 2 me, Where is tha LORD ur God? my eyes shall look her: now shall she be trodden down as tha mire of tha streets.
In tha day dat ur walls r 2 be built, in dat day shall tha decree be far removed.
In dat day also he shall come even 2 u from Assyria, N from tha fortified citiez, N from tha fortress even 2 tha river, N from sea 2 sea, N from mountain 2 mountain.
Even so tha land shall be desolate because of ’em dat live in it, 4 tha fruit of their doings.
Feed ur people wit ur rod, tha flock of thine heritage, which live solitarily in tha wood, in tha midst of Carmel: let ’em feed in Bashan N Gilead, as in tha days of old.
According 2 tha days of ur comin out of tha land of Egypt will I show 2 him marvellous things.
Tha nations shall see N be confounded at all their might: dey shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
Dey shall lick tha dust like a serpent, dey shall move out of their holes like worms of tha earth: dey shall be afraid of tha LORD our God, N shall fear because of u.
Who is a God like 2 u, dat pardoneth iniquity, N passes by tha transgression of tha remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger 4 ever, because he delights in mercy.
He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; N u will cast all their sins in2 tha depths of tha sea.
u will perform tha truth 2 Jacob, N tha mercy 2 Abraham, which u have sworn 2 our fathers from tha days of old.
